label: 3. Hey Cutey, how are you feeling?

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Hey Cutey, how are you feeling?

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: I heard that Laplace came to visit you.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Of course. It is a hero's duty to visit those in need!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: How are you holding up?
Much better, thanks.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: That's great!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: If you're feeling better, why not come visit us?

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Just because he feels better

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: doesn't mean he's been discharged from the hospital.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Fine. Don't come then.
How about you guys? Is everything good?

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Yeah, we're doing all right.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Thanks to Missilis's state-of-the-art technology, we've made a full recovery.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Hurry up and get better

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: so that you can visit us!!
I'll do that.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Syuen and I have caused a lot of trouble for you.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: But thanks to you, we don't have to be implanted with the NIMPH!

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: We won't ever forget what you've done for us.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Words cannot begin to express my gratitude.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Me too! Thank you again!!!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: A hero never forgets those who lend her a helping hand.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Well, I think you two have gotten the point across. No need for me to keep hammering it in.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Seriously? How can you be so rude?

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: I'm just kidding! Of course I'm incredibly grateful.
You all really impressed me.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: You're the one who had it the worst.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: All right, that's enough talking for now. You should rest up.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: See you next time, Cutey.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: See you soon.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Can't wait to see you again, Birdie!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Hero, bye!!
